# Terms of Use Template
## Terms of Use Agreement Overview
### Terms of Use vs. Terms and Conditions
Legally speaking, **a Terms of Use agreement is the same thing as a Terms and Conditions agreement or Terms of Service**.

We're using the phrase "Terms of Use" to describe **a general agreement between you and your users**.

- Terms of Service

## What to Include in Your Terms of Use
2. Rules for your users
3. Legal terms

### 3. Legal Terms
#### General Disclaimers
- Any **malware** contracted by using the site
- The content of any **third-party websites** to which the site links
- The **accuracy of any information** presented by the site

## Download Sample Terms of Use Template
[**Generate Terms of Use in just a few minutes**](https://app.termsfeed.com/wizard/terms-conditions)

- Acknowledgment
- User Accounts
- Content
- Copyright Policy
- Intellectual Property
- Links to Other Websites
- Termination
- Limitation of Liability
- "AS IS" and "AS AVAILABLE" Disclaimer
- Governing Law
- Disputes Resolution
- Severability and Waiver
- Changes
- Contact Information

results.title: Terms of Use vs Terms of Service vs Terms and Conditions - Usercentrics
results.description:
# Terms of Use vs Terms of Service vs Terms and Conditions: How do they compare?
## Terms of Use definition
Terms of Use (ToU), also called Terms of Usage, generally refers to a legal agreement between a website owner and its end users that specifies the rules users must follow when using that site or service.

A Terms of Use policy can include:

- Acceptable behavior and responsibilities for website visitors
- Details on data management, storage, and sharing
- [Website disclaimers](https://usercentrics.com/guides/website-disclaimers/)
- Details on the site owner’s rights if the rules are violated

Usually, a standard Terms of Use includes information about legal liability limits, intellectual property rights, and [copyright disclaimer](https://usercentrics.com/guides/website-disclaimers/copyright-disclaimer/#content-body) notices.

## Best practices for drafting Terms of Use/Terms of Service/Terms and Conditions
- [Apple](https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/terms/site.html) and [Instagram](https://help.instagram.com/581066165581870/?cms_id=581066165581870) both use the name “Terms of Use”
